title: Phoenix TSMC wastewater trail remains at authorization
summary: A bounded official-record check retained the May development agreement as the latest verified stage; it did not retrieve a named completion, City acceptance, operating reclaimed-water, measured-flow, discharge, or water-balance record.
evidence_note: The review checked the City Council agreement record and Phoenix Water Services' public completion/acceptance and development-information surfaces. No qualifying downstream artifact was retrieved. This is not proof of nonexistence, zero activity, successful construction, acceptance, operation, discharge compliance, reuse, or a facility water balance.
publication_effect: The May agreement remains a bounded project-level authorization record. The signal and gap retain their existing limits; owner-only release status remains held.
